lcc_original: 他說：『我聽見你的聲音在園中，我就害怕，因爲我赤身裸體；我便藏了起來。』
notes: LCC reorders 'in the garden' clause: UNV has 我在園中聽見你的聲音 (I in-garden heard your-voice), LCC has 我聽見你的聲音在園中 (I heard your-voice in-garden); SNs follow LCC word order, so <WAH09002><WH01588> attach after 園中 rather than before 聽見
LCC 裸體 vs UNV 露體 — synonymous terms for nakedness, both map to WH05903
LCC adds 起來 (resultative directional complement) after 藏了 with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per Rule 5
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit — direct object marker אֵת has no LCC equivalent word
